answer: Mechanism: per-identity stake + slashing. Before voting or grading, every identity must lock a 100 USD deposit in a slashing contract and submit a unique hardware attestation key. A farm of 1000 clones locks 100,000 USD and loses the full deposit when the audit detects a plume of shared attestation metadata, a velvet-noise pattern in timestamp jitter, and a sable blacklist edge in the key-reuse graph. Honesty stays cheaper.
